title: Great large oven!
text: Great large oven!. I absolutely love this oven. To give you some background, I moved to my new home in Florida last year. With limited resources, I replaced many of the outdated appliances. The one thing I didn't replace was the range/oven. It was a nice gas/electric combo and appeared to be in good shape. Anyway, after using it for about 6 months, I woke up to find the range top working fine (burners) but the inside oven broken. I had to repair guys out here told me it would cost close to $1000 to fix (something to do with needing a mother board). Anyway, long story short, I had been depending on my medium size toaster oven to take the place of the large oven until I can try to replace it. I find it too small for larger things (think an oven roaster chicken). When I saw this Oster, and it was less than $100 (Amazon Warehouse deal), I jumped on it. It is beautiful (stainless steel blends well with my other kitchen appliances), the digital display is clear, large and makes it appear very modern. The size is great, I can fit a chicken in here with no trouble. I will most likely still need to replace my oven (think Thanksgiving), but this will get me through the next 7 months until such time as I can save up for the real thing.

description: The Oster® Extra-Large Air Fry Oven combines extra-large capacity with great features to make it easier to cook multiple meals and sides at once. This digital air fryer features 7 versatile cooking functions including air fry, bake, toast, broil, roast, warm, and pizza that allow you to easily cook your favorite foods. Take the guesswork out of cooking with the easy-to-use digital controls that automatically program time and temperature or use the manual 90-minute timer. For optimal air frying, this oven includes a faster, more powerful fan that circulates hot air so you can add a delicious crisp to all your fried favorites, with little to no oil!* The extra-large capacity and 3 rack positions allow you to cook multiple meals at once. Fit up to 2 large pizzas, 2 full chickens, or three 10.5 x 13-inch baking pans, so you can cook your main dishes and sides simultaneously. The durable stainless steel finish and modern design looks great in every kitchen. Also includes an air fry rack, wire/broil rack, durable baking pan, and removable crumb tray. *compared to 3.7 L deep fryers
